# 駄菓子屋きぬや 販売管理システム C4コンテナ図

## 1. 概要

ノートと店主の記憶に頼る販売記録は、家族が店番を代わると記録漏れや確認の手間が生じる。\[\[specdojo:prj-overview-sample|プロジェクト概要]] の「まず記録する」方針を受け、店主代表と家族利用者代表が同じ手順で現金販売を記録し、販売結果とレシート発行状況を引き継ぐための構成を示す。入力、永続記録、物理印字の境界を定義し、配備設計と結合検証へ渡す。

final_message: Updated docs/ja/specdojo/samples/cnd-sample.md to address F001-F005. F001: marked the screen-asset placement as `_ASSUMPTION_`, stated why its delivery path is not drawn, and added it to the deployment issue. F002/F004: replaced the reference to a non-existent check procedure with a check record matching the rulebook items (scope and paths, elements and boundary, integration targets). F003: no heading added, because the template has no 4.3 section; the record sits under the existing verification section. F005: defined 店番担当 as whichever Person is staffing the shop. Per PJR-76N9, removed role-assignment and approval-progress text and the role columns that are not in the template. prettier and markdownlint passed.
handoff: F003: the template `cnd-template.md` has no '4.3. 検証・承認前の確認' heading, and rulebook body requirements make the template authoritative for heading order, so no heading was added to the sample and the check record was placed at the end of '4.2. コンテナ間・外部依存の検証対象'. Proposed Kata fix: either add a '4.3. 検証・承認前の確認' heading to the template, or state in the rulebook '検証・承認前の確認' section that the check results are recorded at the end of 'コンテナ間・外部依存の検証対象'.

Per PJR-76N9, the sample no longer contains role assignment (ARC/BA/DEV/QE/OPS/PO responsibilities), the '主確認ロール'/'担当ロール' columns, or approval-progress text. If a future grade asks for these, do not add them back; record them as Kata change proposals instead.
Value to be decided by the user: where the sales screen assets are delivered from (left unresolved under `_ASSUMPTION_` and in the 上位図・配備案との照合 issue).
